title: capparis indica
intro: Capparis indica, commonly known as the Indian caper or Ceylon caper, is a plant species belonging to the family Capparaceae, characterized by its perennial habit and ability to thrive in dry, stony, and alkaline soils. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, inflammation, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Capparis indica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
